text_block_list.text:
—! Could you somehow put me in touch with 
her!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It pains me greatly, but... as I have been 
saying, there is truly nothing I can do...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, on my way back to the academy, 
Mejiro Ardan was being pressed by a man. 
She was visibly troubled, so—
choice_data_list: Are you all right? Should I call security?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... thank you for your concern. But 
there is no need for that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This gentleman is an editor for a 
magazine, you see... but it seems he is 
deeply distressed over my older sister.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. Regarding my sister— Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—You flatter yourself into believing you 
have said everything with just goodness 
and beauty.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Instantly, that cold expression of hers 
came to mind. At first, they seemed like 
ice, but those beautifully shining eyes 
possessing genuine weight were just like—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Well... it seems my sister was slated to 
appear in a special feature this gentleman 
planned, but...

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text:
She suddenly turned it down~! And she did 
it so politely, so courteously, and with 
such immaculate manners!!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text:
What's more, I haven't been able to reach 
her once since... In desperation, I came 
to the academy, and happened to run into 
her younger sister!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, why so suddenly...? I had heard she 
was whimsical, but still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...First, allow me to apologize on my 
sister's behalf for any discourtesy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My sister is indeed whimsical. However, 
she would never break a promise without 
reason.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I know it is presumptuous to ask, but do 
you have any idea what might have dampened 
her spirits...?

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I only explained up to the point 
that the shoot's concept was "Jewels", and 
that we'd liken Ramonu-san to one of 
them...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A horse girl like a jewel—certainly that 
was true. Yet on that day, standing before 
the painting, she was no mere silent stone 
meant only to be admired.
choice_data_list:
Did you explain why you wanted her to be a 
jewel?

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text:
I told her it was because Ramonu-san is 
just like a jewel, but... Wait, was that 
not good...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...My sister sees through to the essence 
of things. If she judged it to be 
superficial—lacking in true sentiment, 
that is...

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text:
L-Lacking in sentiment?! That's not true 
at all! Because this project is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, a car pulled up in front of the 
dormitory across from the school gates. 
The one who stepped out was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Thank you. You may return.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Sister...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what good timing. I have just picked 
out a few dresses.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I shall have them delivered, so you must 
take a look as well. Until later.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text:
Ramonu-san!! ...I am a fan of yours! A 
devout worshiper! I love you!!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text:
I fell for you on the turf... for your 
fierce, devastating beauty. Day after day 
since then, I have chased your running... 
burning that beauty into my eyes!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text:
"If you can persuade her, you can go ahead 
with the feature." When my boss gave the 
green light, I was so truly happy! From 
the bottom of my heart, truly...

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text:
!! I want to make the whole world aware of 
your beauty! If you would grant me, please 
give me one more chance!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an impassioned speech that couldn't 
help but stir the heart. Mejiro Ardan was 
nodding lightly as well. If this passion 
got through, surely even she would—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Forgive me, but what are you talking 
about?

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text: ...Gh-hk?!!!! Ahe-ahe-aheee!?!?!?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
S-Sister! Come now, about the magazine 
feature...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I am afraid I do not recall. Such stories 
are far too common, and—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
that gaze of yours is quite ordinary as 
well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose I could accept. Provided 
the schedule aligns.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I must choose some accessories now. Excuse 
me.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text:
............Huh? Did I... just get 
permission...?

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAAAAY!!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text:
I get to work with Ramonu-san...! Thank 
God, thank her supreme beauty, thank you, 
thank you—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Sister... Truly, what a sinful person...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps declining the offer had simply 
been a passing whim as well. As if 
laughing off all of our deep 
contemplation...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu lined up with glittering 
jewels... It would undoubtedly be gorgeous 
beyond belief, something out of this 
world... So I found myself thinking.
